briefdescription.para: Compute the inverse of a minor symmetric fourth order 3D Fastor tensor.

parameterdescription.para: a minor symmetric fourth order Fastor tensor

simplesect.para: the inverse of the input tensor

A minor symmetric fourth order tensor is a fourth order tensor that is symmetric with respect to the first and second pair of indices, i.e. $ C_{ijkl} = C_{jikl} = C_{ijlk} $. It actually computes $ C^{-1}_{ijkl} $ such that $ C^{-1}_{ijmn} C_{mnkl} = \delta_{ik}\delta_{jl} $ using Mandel notation and Fastor's inverse function for second order tensors.
